app.title: The ZINN App
app.description: Ukuqashelwa kwezinkolo okusekelwe ku-CBT ngezibonakaliso ze-AI

settingsDialogs.themeDesc: Khetha itimu oyithandayo noma ushintshe ngokuzenzakalela ngosuku nosuku.
settingsDialogs.textSizeDesc: Lungisa usayizi wombhalo kuyo yonke i-app ukuze kubelula kufunda. Miswa ku-130% ukuze kugcinwe isimo ekusetshenzisweni kweselula.

beliefs.title: Izinkolo Neziqinisekiso
beliefs.subtitle: Faka izinkolo, iziqinisekiso, nefilosofi yakho. I-AI izokuqandanisa futhi ihlukanise.
beliefs.enterPlaceholder: Faka {type} yakho... Izaga nemeqo ongipila ngayo noma ouyizwile kabanomunye...
beliefs.analyzing: I-AI ihlaziya inkolo yakho futhi ikhiqiza okuhlobene...
beliefs.noEntriesDesc: Engeza inkolo yakho, isiqinisekiso noma ifilosofi yakho yokuqala ngenhla.
beliefs.deleteDesc: Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukususa le nkolo? Lokhu akukwazi ukubuyiselwa.

socialAnalysis.title: Ukuhlaziya Okomphakathi
socialAnalysis.subtitle: Hlukanis phakathi kwezinkolo, iziqinisekiso, nefilosofi ezenza kahle nomphakathi nezilwa nomphakathi.
socialAnalysis.enterPlaceholder: Faka inkolo, isiqinisekiso noma ifilosofi ukunika isimo, kusuka ekubonweni okuxhasa nomphakathi uma kunenjalo noma okulwa nomphakathi...
socialAnalysis.noProSocial: Akukho okungenayo okuxhasa nomphakathi okwamanje. Engeza izinkolo esigabeni sezinkolo.
socialAnalysis.noAntiSocial: Akukho okungenayo okulwa nomphakathi okwamanje. Engeza izinkolo esigabeni sezinkolo.

thinkingReport.title: Imbiko Yemicabango
thinkingReport.subtitle: Ukuhlaziya kwe-CBT mayelana nomcabango. Gaza lokho ongakwazi, bese i-AI igcwalisisa okuseleyo.
thinkingReport.micInstruction: Thinta imakrofoni, bese uthinta inkundla ukuze uqondise okungenayo kolimi olukhulunywa lapho.
thinkingReport.disputingThoughtPlaceholder: Yiziphi izibonelo ezisiza ngalo m cabango?
thinkingReport.replacementThoughtPlaceholder: Yisiphi isinyathelo esihle esingathathwa ngalom cabango?
thinkingReport.associatedBeliefPlaceholder: Iyiphi inkolo ephansi enezinhlonzho ezihambisana nalo m cabango?
thinkingReport.noReportsDesc: Qala ngokufaka umcabango wakho wokuqala ngenhla.

boundaries.title: Imikhawulo
boundaries.subtitle: Imikhawulo ekhiqizwa i-AI egqamisa izinkolo zakho ezenza kahle nomphakathi kuzo zonke izinhlobo zemikhawulo.
boundaries.generateDesc: Khetha inkolo ethile ezenza kahle nomphakathi ukuze kuzuzwe imikhawulo ekhethekile, noma ikhiqize kuzo zonke izinkolo.
boundaries.addBeliefsFirst: Engeza kokuqala izinkolo ezenza kahle nomphakathi ukuze kuzuzwe imikhawulo.
boundaries.analyzing: I-AI ikhiqiza imikhawulo ehambisana nezinkolo zakho...
boundaries.noBoundariesDesc: Engeza kokuqala izinkolo ezenza kahle nomphakathi, bese ukhipha imikhawulo.
boundaries.deleteAllConfirm: Susa yonke imikhawulo {count}? Lokhu akukwazi ukubuyiselwa.
boundaries.deleteDesc: Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukususa "{title}"? Lokhu akukwazi ukubuyiselwa.

maslow.title: Ukubekwa Kwezingqikithi Zamadinga EBandlaika Kuka-Maslow
maslow.subtitle: Hlaziya ukuthi ngabe ngamaphi amadinga angazuzwa angaphephisa imicabango nokuziphatha kwakho kumibiko ye-CBT.
maslow.analyzeReportDesc: Khetha imbiko yemicabango ukuze igcwaliswe ngokuzenzakalela imicabango nokuziphatha kwayo, bese i-AI ithola amadinga angazuzwa.
maslow.noReports: Akukho mimiko yemicabango okwamanje. Engeza okokuqala esigabeni semibiko yemicabango.
maslow.noAnalysesDesc: Khetha imbiko yemicabango ngenhla ukuze uqale.
maslow.analyzing: I-AI ihlaziya amadinga akho kuzo zonke izingqikithi zika-Maslow...

selfAwareness.gratefulForPlaceholder: Yiziphi izinto ezi-3 ongibulela ngazo kakhulu namuhla?
selfAwareness.noEntriesToday: Akukho okungenayo okwamanje namuhla. Qala ukubhala ngenhla.
selfAwareness.analyzingDay: I-AI ihlaziya okungenayo kwanamuhla kwepheshana lezinkomba...
selfAwareness.analyzingMonth: I-AI ihlaziya inyanga iphela ukuthola izakamuwo...

spiritual.title: Okomoya
spiritual.subtitle: Izibhalo, iziqinisekiso, nefilosofi ezikhiqizwe epheshaneni lakho lezinkomba
spiritual.noEntries: Akukho okungenayo kwezinkomba okunemcabango noma okunesimpendulo okwamanje. Engeza okungenayo ekuqapheleni okukuqala.
spiritual.analyzing: I-AI isha izibhalo futhi idala ukuphendula...
spiritual.noReflections: Akukho okuphendulayo okwamanje. Khetha okungenayo kwezinkomba bese ukhipha ukuphendula kwakho kokuqala ngesibhalo.

scriptureLookup.title: Ukubuka Izibhalo
scriptureLookup.subtitle: Cinga ngokwesibonelo, ngesiqeshana somusho noma ngokusukumisa — i-AI ithola isahluko bese ikhiqiza isiqinisekiso nefilosofi ehambisanayo.
scriptureLookup.placeholder: isb. 'Ujohana 3:16', 'ulithanda ulwela abantu, uliyabakhathalela', noma 'okokuthi ungakhathazeki ngakusasa'...
scriptureLookup.replaceNoticeProSocial: Lokhu kubuyisela yonke imibhalo ezenza kahle nomphakathi kokuphendulayo okukhethiwe ngale miphumela entsha.
scriptureLookup.replaceNoticeAntiSocial: Lokhu kubuyisela yonke imibhalo ezilwa nomphakathi kokuphendulayo okukhethiwe ngale miphumela entsha.
scriptureLookup.enterSearchError: Faka isibonelo sesibhalo noma isiqeshana somusho ukuze ucinge.
scriptureLookup.searchFailedError: Ukucingwa kwesibhalo kwehluleka. Phinda uzame futhi.

disclaimer.title: Isexwayiso Sokugula Nokwengqondo
disclaimer.intro: Le app ("The ZINN App") iyithuluzi elihlelwa i-AI elifundisa futhi elibuka ngokuzijabulisa elingahlangothi laka-Maslow wezinkathi ezithathe phambili mayelana nezingqikithi ezingama-5 zamadinga emuntu.
disclaimer.section1Title: 1. Asiyona Izeluleko Yokugula, Yokwengqondo, Noma Yokuphila Komuntu
disclaimer.section1Body: I-AI yale app ihlaziya umbhalo noma okufakwe umuntu ukuze kuhambisane nezinkalo ezijwayelekile zomzimba wokuzimisela nokungazuzwa kwamadinga. Loku kuhlaziya akusho ukugcina isimo se-clinical psychological, ukuvivinywa ngokwengqondo, ukwelashwa kokugula komuntu noma ihlelo lokwelapha.
disclaimer.section2Title: 2. Akukho Budlelwano BukaDokotela Nonesiguli Noma BukaTherapeuthi Nomsizi
disclaimer.section2Body: Ukusebenzisa le app, ama-algorithms ayo e-AI, noma yimuphi umphumela noma izeluleko eziyikhisho akusho ukuthi ukhona ebudlelwaneni nomTherapeuthi Nomsizi, Dokotela nesiguli, noma nosetshenziswa olungokaPhezulu lokunakekelwa kwezempilo phakathi kwakho ne-The ZINN App.
disclaimer.section3Body: Le app ayinamandla okulawula, ukuhlola noma ukwelapha izimo eziphuthumayo ezingokwengqondo. Uma uphila isimo esiphuthumayo ngokwengqondo, usizi olukhulu, noma imicabango yokuzenza kabi, sicela uxhume namasevisi okuphuthumayo noma umugqa wamahhala wezokwengqondo osemshini wakho ngokushesha.
disclaimer.section4Body: Yonke imiselwe nge-AI ihlakaniphile ngeseluleko nangemfundo yodwa. Kufanele njalo uxhume nososayense bengqondo abakelayo, udokotela bengqondo, noma ochwephehe bokugala ngaphambi kokuthi ushintshe kakhulu indlela yokuphila noma ukuziphatha ngokusekelwe kumiphumela yale app. Ukusetshenziswa kwale app kusezingxenyeni ezonelayo iphela.
disclaimer.acceptLabel: Ngiyifundile futhi ngiyayiqonda i-sexwayiso Sokugula Nokwengqondo. Ngiyayamukela imithetho futhi ngiyabona ukuthi le app iyithuluzi lokufunda, ayiyona isevisi yokugula noma yokwengqondo.
disclaimer.contextual: Isexwayiso: Loku kuhlaziya kukhiqizwa ngohlelo lokwenza okuhlakaniphile okusebenzisa izinkathi ezithathe phambili (Ukubekwa Kwamadinga Kuka-Maslow) njengesibonelo sokufunda. Imiphumela ye-AI ingase ibe yamaphutha noma ingagcwaliswa. Lokhu asiyona ithuluzi lokuhlola noma ukuhlola kwengqondo. Sicela uxhume ochwephehe abakelayo ukuze uthole izeluleko ngokwengqondo noma ukuhlola okusemthethweni.
